Population by municipality of Mexico, ITER 2010

Source: R/data.R
pop2010.Rd

Population of each municipality of Mexico by sex and age group, from the territorial indicators (ITER, *Integración Territorial*) of the 2010 Population and Housing Census of INEGI. Useful as denominators to calculate incidence rates.

Usage

pop2010

Format

A tibble with 2,456 rows (municipalities) and 44 columns. All population columns are numeric:

CVEGEO

five-digit municipality code of INEGI (state + municipality).

pobtot

total population.

pobfem

female population.

pobmas

male population.

p_0a2

population aged 0 to 2 years.

p_0a2_f

female population aged 0 to 2 years.

p_0a2_m

male population aged 0 to 2 years.

p_3ymas

population aged 3 years and over.

p_3ymas_f

female population aged 3 years and over.

p_3ymas_m

male population aged 3 years and over.

p_5ymas

population aged 5 years and over.

p_5ymas_f

female population aged 5 years and over.

p_5ymas_m

male population aged 5 years and over.

p_12ymas_f

female population aged 12 years and over.

p_12ymas_m

male population aged 12 years and over.
